semantics.model_binding: Static import-resolved class-body model assignments create USES_DATA edges to a unique in-repo model.
semantics.queryset_binding: Recognized Book.objects and conservative chained queryset methods can establish the same model relationship.
semantics.explicit_template: A literal template_name creates a template_render contract only when it uniquely maps to an in-repo template and no custom get_template_names override makes the render uncertain.
semantics.default_template: Supported Django generic CBV conventions infer templates only from a unique grounded model and unique existing template; evidence is marked framework-inferred, not static.
semantics.uncertainty: Ambiguous imports, dynamic querysets/templates, conflicting model/queryset bindings, custom template selection, missing/ambiguous templates remain unresolved instead of producing an edge.
